The '''confliction gauntlets''' are an upgraded variant of the [[tormented bracelet]] requiring level 90 [[Hitpoints]] to wear, providing best-in-slot magic attack and [[magic damage]] bonuses. They are made with level 83 [[Crafting]] and level 70 [[Smithing]] by attaching the [[Mokhaiotl cloth]], a rare untradeable drop from the [[Doom of Mokhaiotl]], to a [[tormented bracelet]] alongside 10,000 [[demon tear]]s. This process '''must''' be done at a [[bank]] and is not reversible.

Compared to the [[tormented bracelet]], the gauntlets gain +10 magic attack bonus, some defensive bonuses and a +2% magic damage bonus, alongside a [[passive effect]] with one-handed magic weapons.

==Passive effect==
The gauntlets have a passive effect that occurs upon a missed magic attack, which causes the next magic attack of that weapon or spell against the same enemy to roll accuracy twice. When using multi-target spells (e.g. [[Blood Barrage]]), the passive effect will only roll accuracy twice against the primary target of the spell; secondary targets will roll accuracy once as normal.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/varlamore-the-final-dawn-out-now?oldschool=1|title=Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now|newsdate=23 July 2025|quote=[The passive] [o]nly applies to the same spell and the same target - so no funny business!}} However, the passive effect does not apply at all when casting ice spells against other players, including against the primary target.{{CiteVideo|author=Gnomonkey|title=PVM to PVP: My DMM Allstars Experience (OSRS)|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lJexGv6dxu8|timestamp=7:40|date=24 june 2026|site=YouTube}}{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Ash|url=https://discord.com/channels/324132423636090880/434286997360738305/1408017881219862548|date=21 August 2025|quote=Where that's applied in a multi-target spell, it looks to me like it'll apply to ONE player, but not to the rest of the group. Interestingly, I can't actually see it being checked for the ice spells, only for the smoke, shadow & blood ones. This isn't my code, though, and I may simply be missing something.|ctxquote=@JagexAsh probably a question only you can answer lol - in pvp multi situations, does the confliction gauntlets passive effect only work on the player you're targeting or each player individually that's being affected by your ice barrage cast in the 3x3 clump}} This effect only works when casting spells [[unarmed]] or with a [[One-handed slot table|one-handed weapon]] equipped; it is disabled if a [[Two-handed slot table|two-handed weapon]] is equipped.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/varlamore-the-final-dawn-out-now?oldschool=1|title=Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now|newsdate=23 July 2025|quote=Works only with 1-handed or no weapons (sorry, Shadow).}}

===Successful hit chance===
As the effect of the Confliction gauntlets is variable depending on one's base accuracy, it has virtually no effect when the player's base accuracy is 95% and above, and grows to around +30% with a base accuracy of under 10%. An approximate average of the gauntlets' effects are given by the following formula:

<math>
\text{Hit Chance} = \text{P}_{base} * (1.3275 - 0.36 \text{P}_{base})
</math>

The precise average [[Damage_per_second/Magic#Step_six:_Calculate_the_hit_chance|probability]] of landing a successful hit on an opponent can be determined by the following formula:

<math>
\text{Hit Chance} = \frac{\text{P}_{two}}{(1 + \text{P}_{two} - \text{P}_{one})}\quad 
</math>

Where <math>\text{P}_{one}</math> is the base hit chance with one accuracy roll and <math>\text{P}_{two}</math> is the hit chance with two accuracy rolls.

Calculating the base hit chance probabilities with one accuracy roll can be done as normal, and with two accuracy rolls following the formulas for [[Osmumten's Fang]] (when used outside the Tombs of Amascut):

<math>
\text{Hit Chance}_{one} = \begin{cases}
 \displaystyle 1-\frac{(d+2)}{2 (a+1)}, & \quad \text{when } a \ge d, \text{ and} \\
 \displaystyle \frac{a}{2 (d+1)}, & \quad \text{when } a < d.
\end{cases}
</math>

<math>
\text{Hit Chance}_{two} = \begin{cases}
 \displaystyle 1-\frac{(d+2) (2 d+3)}{6 (a+1)^2}, & \quad \text{when } a \ge d, \text{ and} \\
 \displaystyle \frac{a (4 a+5)}{6 (a+1) (d+1)}, & \quad \text{when } a < d.
\end{cases}
</math>

==Development history==
The passive effect of the confliction gauntlets was initially proposed without any restrictions.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/new-delve-boss-rewards---varlamore-the-final-dawn?oldschool=1|title=New Delve Boss Rewards - Varlamore: The Final Dawn|newsdate=11 March 2025|quote=When you miss a Magic attack with the Gauntlets equipped, your next Magic attack of the same type (same weapon or spell), against the same enemy, will roll Accuracy twice. This means that if you're already hitting all of the time (looking at you, Shadow) you won't be benefiting much, but if your Accuracy is more middling you'll see some great returns.}} However, player concerns of making the [[Tumeken's shadow]] too powerful led to changes to prevent the gauntlets from interacting with it. The first change considered was for the passive to only apply for 4 ticks after a missed attack.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/new-delve-boss-rewards---varlamore-the-final-dawn?oldschool=1|title=New Delve Boss Rewards - Varlamore: The Final Dawn|newsdate=24 March 2025|quote=When it comes to the Gauntlets, we hear your concerns regarding the Shadow. This reward, and project as a whole, doesn't have the scope to address specific Shadow issues, so what we have opted to do is make a tweak to the description of the passive. The Confliction Gauntlets' passive now reads: When a Magic attack misses, your next Magic attack within 4 ticks rolls accuracy twice. This means that you have 4 ticks to use the effect, with no down period between uses making you miss effects on other items. It's worth noting that this has to be against the same target and using the same spell or magic weapon. The same effect applies for a PvP target.}} Due to player concerns that this would cause the gauntlets to not benefit [[standard spellbook]] or [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, it was changed to its current effect instead, where the passive only functions with one-handed weapons. This restriction has been stated to potentially be removed in the future, if a theoretical rework of the Tumeken's shadow is released.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/new-delve-boss-rewards---varlamore-the-final-dawn?oldschool=1|title=New Delve Boss Rewards - Varlamore: The Final Dawn|newsdate=28 March 2025|quote=That being said, our 'bandaid fix' for the Confliction Gauntlets was a tad divisive. In the short term, we're not going to be able to avoid a bandaid fix, but we do this in the knowledge that said bandaids can be pulled off whenever changes to Tumeken's Shadow are implemented. Some players pointed out that restricting the Gauntlets' effect to atacks within the next 4 ticks meant that Standard spells or Ancient Magicks wouldn't be able to benefit from them. This wasn't an oversight, we had some concerns around use-cases like freezes in PvP, blood spell healing in content where it's typically too inaccurate to be worth using, or potentially having to curtail Elemental Weaknesses to account for additional accuracy. We're not dead-set on any of these being overly problematic, so we'll be adjusting the Confliction Gauntlets' passive effect to remove the 4-tick restriction and instead benefit one-handed weapons only.}}
